additional_info.subject: RE: ID0382081-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / R2 312555359/24] Screen out of order CRM:00642001566
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
As per trailing mail reported issue regarding black terminal screen, please take the following action on your end, as it will assist in resolving the problem.
1.
Please reboot the charger.
1. The DP cable needs to be replaced. Use a new 1.5m cable (Official Siemens spare part only, no other brands), and ensure it is routed as far away from routers as possible to avoid EMC performance issues, as identified by R&D.
2. Verify the 24VDC power supply is set to 25VDC.
3. Additionally, check whether the LED strips are faulty.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0374481
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
Please refer to the attached knowledge article link for more information.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_HMI_Black_Screen/Scrambled_Screen - Dynamics 365
